selected_family.name: Karstadt-Schwartz Alternative-Basis Strassen
selected_family.definition: stationary 2x2 rank-7 recursion, frozen uniform recursion depth, classical leaves
selected_family.why_new_in_project: No prior project branch/commit matched alternative-basis/ABMM/Winograd-variant; the family changes the basis/linear phase of a rank-7 Strassen leaf rather than changing tensor rank or the contraction DAG.

primary_sources.claim_used: Alternative basis reduces the leading arithmetic coefficient for 2x2 rank-7 Strassen.
Exact phi/nu basis maps; 7 multiplications and 12 bilinear additions; exact ring identity.
Alternative-basis matrix multiplication has a normwise-stability theory; R212 nevertheless keeps an empirical float32 gate.

production_cost_gate.lower_bound_scope: Mandatory rank-7 classical leaves plus mandatory 12 bilinear additions per recursive 2x2 node. All basis transforms, copies, materialization, padding, setup, integration and runtime are set to zero.
production_cost_gate.depths_checked: all integer uniform recursion depths L=0..10
production_cost_gate.blocker: Even the optimistic lower bound is 0.4889167547 of classical, above the frozen 0.42 mechanism gate. Basis-transform and integration costs can only increase it.

float32_gate.reason: Synthetic execution is authorized only after cost feasibility. The lower-bound cost gate failed.

reusable_conclusion: Stationary 2x2 rank-7 Karstadt-Schwartz Alternative-Basis Strassen cannot meet the R206/H185 0.42 production mechanism gate at n=1024 even when basis-transform, materialization, setup and integration costs are optimistically set to zero.
scope_caveat: This terminal result does not cover different base sizes/ranks or higher-dimensional decomposed-recursive alternative-basis algorithms; those are different algorithmic families.
